name: Nourish Daily
description: Smart meal planning and nutrition tracking PWA with Ayurvedic principles

fixes: Prepare ticks are saved per local date (chk_<YYYY-MM-DD>_<item>), so every list resets daily
Night Tasks/Groceries were saved per weekday and reappeared ticked the next week; Custom Ingredients never reset
Ticks from earlier days and pre-1.6.7 keys are removed on load; today's Daily Essentials ticks carry over
Today and Weekly look up custom picks by id (resolveSelection) instead of showing the title/description copied when the pick was saved
Editing a meal refreshes the Today and Weekly tabs
Diet-friendly grouping only applies to pre-1.6.0 copies (df_<time>_<type>) via mealGroupId, with exact id matching instead of prefix matching
Deleting one diet-friendly meal no longer deletes other meals sharing an id prefix (imported_<type>_..., cm_1 vs cm_10)
Diet-friendly meals with similar ids are no longer hidden in Manage and Recipes
Custom recipes with ids without an underscore can be deleted from Manage
Prepare tab lists all diet-friendly meals needing an ingredient
Import validates and cleans every entry before saving: known fields only, escaped text, safe ids, valid meal types, string ingredients
Invalid entries are skipped and counted instead of failing the whole import after partially saving
Custom meal ids that could impersonate default meals are replaced
Stored meals and recipes from earlier unsafe imports are repaired on load
Title deduplication compares decoded text so escaped and raw titles match
Weekly tab validates today's selections, so deleted custom meals fall back to the default plan
isValidSelection shared between Today and Weekly
Deleting from Customize refreshes Today, Weekly, Recipes and Manage
Deleting from Manage refreshes Weekly and Recipes for all meal types
Customize no longer runs out of meals: used meals are derived from this week's selections (Sun-Sat) instead of a list that never reset
Today's pick is never blocked, so it can be changed; Reset frees it
Removed legacy nd_used_meals storage key
Greyed-out options show a 'Had this week' label
Fixed Add Meal (+) button crash from removed recipe-content-group element
Cancelled Edit no longer hijacks the next Add Meal save
Edit form decodes stored values so names are not re-escaped on every edit
Update toast no longer shown on first service worker install
Weekly tab escapes meal titles before rendering
CSP allows Google Fonts stylesheet and font files
Export alert shows real line breaks
Added missing PWA icons (72-512px) plus favicon and apple-touch-icon links

features: Simplified Add Meal form - always show meal type selector
Diet-friendly option now just adds 🥗 tag (no special form)
Single meal per type (not all 3 meal types)
Cleaner unified form for all meal types
Export now includes mealOptions for editable backup
Backup contains all default + custom meals combined
Edit JSON and reimport workflow supported
Export button to download all user data (meals, recipes, selections)
Import restores selections (meal choices per day)
Selection validation prevents stale/deleted meals showing in Today tab
fixes: Fixed deleted custom meals appearing in Today tab
Fixed data persistence on app updates

features: Version-based cache busting for service worker
Update notification toast when new version available

fixes: Fixed Customize button crash (missing STORE keys)
Fixed Today tab layout (CSS specificity)
Added usedBreakfast/usedLunch/usedDinner to STORE
Recipe card layout with proper CSS grid
Import now adds meals to Recipes tab
Title-based deduplication for imports

features: Filter buttons (All, Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Diet-Friendly)
Visual tags with icons for meal types
Combined view of all meal options

fixes: Removed '2 Boiled Egg Whites' from snacks
Fixed customize button ID reference
Shortened manage tab button labels

features: Dynamic UI refresh after adding meals
